newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - CPC raised to outperform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CPC raised to outperform.

text.p: -- Goldman Sachs analyst Nomi Ghez said Wednesday she raised her rating on CPC International Inc to market outperformer from market performer after the company said it plans to spin off its corn refining operations.
-- "We welcome this decision, which makes a lot of sense for CPC," Ghez wrote in a report. "The company will now be a pure branded food company, with improved cash flow and more reliable earnings..."
-- She added the stock's multiple should rise at least in line with the average food group multiple, which is currently 20 times 1997 and 17.5 times 1998 earnings.
-- Corn refining equity will be $750 million to $850 million, or $5 to $6 per CPC share, Ghez said. CPC shares were up two at 84 a share.
-- Ghez said CPC's continuing operations should earn about $4.00 a share in 1997 and $4.50 in 1998.

-- "The continuing operations, with 65 percent of profits outside the U.S., have strong brands and market leadership in mnay countries, particularly in Latin America (20 percent of profits) and Europe (35 percent of profits)," she said. "The North American operations are somewhat lackluster, but the new focus may somewhat accelerate their growth."
